inputs.text: This “unity” between China and the United States looks like a managed performance, not a real breakthrough. Making Donald Trump’s second withdrawal the centerpiece gives the public an easy villain and keeps attention away from the interests steering the climate agenda. The talk of laying groundwork for the Paris Agreement makes a contested agenda sound like common sense and shared progress. That’s precisely why people should ask who benefits—and why the polished story is being pushed so hard.
